items.title: 2027 board exam date sheet not yet listed
items.summary: As of 9 Nov 2026, no notice for the Class X and XII 2027 main exam date sheet is listed on the official CBSE circulars or press pages. Dates will be shown here once CBSE publishes them. Please check the official site for the latest.

items.title: 2027 practical exam schedule not yet issued
items.summary: As of 9 Nov 2026, no notice on practical exam dates or guidelines for schools in general for the 2027 boards is listed on the official CBSE circulars page. Your school will share dates once CBSE announces them.

items.title: Subject-wise marks bifurcation for 2026-27 released
items.summary: CBSE issued a circular on 6 Nov 2026 listing, subject by subject, the theory, practical and internal assessment marks, exam duration and answer book type for Classes X and XII. Check your subjects in the PDF.

items.title: Circular for winter-bound schools on practicals and internal assessment
items.summary: On 5 Nov 2026 CBSE issued a circular on conducting practical exams, project assessment and internal assessment for Classes X and XII in winter-bound schools for 2026-27. Only the title could be read, so see the PDF for details.

items.title: CBSE issues notice on correction of LOC data
items.summary: CBSE published a circular titled 'Correction of LOC data 2026-27' on 2 Nov 2026. The PDF text could not be read, so please check the official notice for the process and dates, and talk to your school.

items.title: LOC submission for 2026-27 main exams has closed
items.summary: CBSE issued the LOC circular on 21 Sep 2026 and sent reminders until 21 Oct 2026, which it called the last date. Ask your school to confirm that your name, subjects and details were entered correctly.

items.title: 2026-27 curriculum for Classes 9 to 12 is released
items.summary: CBSE released its curriculum for the 2026-27 session in April 2026 (circular Acad-14/2026). Download your subject syllabus from the Academic website.
